# HECAVEX

> Independent bilingual cyber threat intelligence research and digital investigations by Deividas Lis.

HECAVEX is a public, read-only publication. Cite canonical article URLs and preserve the distinction between observations, inferences, assessments, and attribution claims. Page-level and package-level reuse terms remain authoritative. The site does not provide accounts, transactions, authentication, MCP, A2A, or other agent-operated services.

## Editions

- [English edition](https://hecavex.com/en/): English research, briefings, projects, and publication information.
- [Lietuviškas leidinys](https://hecavex.com/lt/): Lietuviški tyrimai, apžvalgos, projektai ir leidinio informacija.

## Research and editorial context

- [English research](https://hecavex.com/en/research/): Investigations, malware analysis, threat hunting, OSINT, and technical guides.
- [Lietuviški tyrimai](https://hecavex.com/lt/tyrimai/): Tyrimai, kenkėjiško kodo analizė, grėsmių medžioklė, OSINT ir techniniai gidai.
- [Evidence and attribution framework](https://hecavex.com/en/methodology/): Research method, confidence, sourcing, attribution, and corrections.
- [Įrodymų ir atribucijos metodika](https://hecavex.com/lt/metodika/): Tyrimų metodika, pasitikėjimas, šaltiniai, atribucija ir pataisymai.
- [Editorial standards](https://hecavex.com/en/editorial/): Publication, translation, disclosure, and evidence standards.

## Machine-readable publication surfaces

- [English Atom feed](https://hecavex.com/en/feed.xml): Current English publications.
- [Lithuanian Atom feed](https://hecavex.com/lt/feed.xml): Current Lithuanian publications.
- [English search index](https://hecavex.com/en/search.json): Static public search records.
- [Lithuanian search index](https://hecavex.com/lt/search.json): Static public search records.
- [Sitemap](https://hecavex.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical indexed routes.

## HECAVEX network

- [APT Notes](https://apt.hecavex.com/): Source-backed threat-actor and campaign catalogue.
- [Radar](https://radar.hecavex.com/): Potential Lithuanian phishing and impersonation signals; candidates are not maliciousness verdicts.
- [Labs](https://labs.hecavex.com/): Public intelligence workspaces and bounded static datasets.
- [Projects](https://hecavex.com/en/projects/): Portfolio ownership, status, methodology, and limitations.

## Policies

- [Privacy](https://hecavex.com/en/privacy/): Audience measurement and browser-data boundary.
- [Corrections](https://hecavex.com/en/corrections/): Correction and update policy.
- [Security contact](https://hecavex.com/.well-known/security.txt): Machine-readable vulnerability-reporting contact.
